name: sentry
description: Watch PRs outside the model: polls CI, reviews and threads with gh, wakes the session only when something actionable happens, and denies sleep-poll loops while it watches.

intervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often sentry polls each watched PR with gh.

wake.title: Wake the session
wake.description: actionable: submit a one-line prompt when a PR fails, becomes ready, gets changes requested or a new thread, merges or closes. never: only toast and redraw.
